```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

library(DBI)
library(RSQLite)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(DT)

source("helpers.R")

# ── Paths ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
DB_PATH    <- "../data/paperboy_monitor.sqlite"
STATUS_CSV <- "../data/status.csv"

# ── Load data ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
status_info <- read.csv(STATUS_CSV, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

init_db(DB_PATH)
results <- get_latest_results(DB_PATH, status_info)
runs    <- get_run_history(DB_PATH)

# ── Summary counts ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
n_total    <- nrow(status_info)
n_ok       <- sum(results$health == "ok",                   na.rm = TRUE)
n_degraded <- sum(results$health == "degraded",             na.rm = TRUE)
n_broken   <- sum(results$health %in% c("broken", "error"), na.rm = TRUE)
n_no_rss   <- sum(results$health == "no_rss",               na.rm = TRUE)

# ── Last run timestamp ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ts       <- results$tested_at[!is.na(results$tested_at)]
last_run <- if (length(ts) == 0) "Never tested" else
  paste("Last run:", format(max(as.POSIXct(ts)), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M UTC"))

# ── Colour helpers ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
health_bg  <- c(ok = "#d4edda", degraded = "#fff3cd", broken = "#f8d7da",
                error = "#f8d7da", no_rss = "#e9ecef", untested = "#e9ecef")
health_col <- c(ok = "#155724", degraded = "#856404", broken = "#721c24",
                error = "#721c24", no_rss = "#495057", untested = "#495057")

# ── Domain detail setup ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
all_domains <- sort(status_info$domain)

domain_histories <- lapply(setNames(all_domains, all_domains), function(d) {
  get_domain_history(DB_PATH, d)
})

# Pre-render one PNG per domain into assets/plots/
plots_dir <- "assets/plots"
dir.create(plots_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

offsets <- c(Headline = -0.9, Datetime = -0.3, Author = 0.3, Text = 0.9)

for (d in all_domains) {
  h        <- domain_histories[[d]]
  png_path <- file.path(plots_dir, paste0(gsub("[^a-zA-Z0-9]", "-", d), ".png"))

  png(png_path, width = 800, height = 300, res = 96)

  if (nrow(h) == 0) {
    p <- ggplot() +
      annotate("text", x = 0.5, y = 0.5, label = "No test history yet",
               size = 6, colour = "grey60") +
      theme_void()
  } else {
    p <- h |>
      mutate(tested_at = as.POSIXct(tested_at)) |>
      pivot_longer(
        cols      = c(pct_headline, pct_datetime, pct_author, pct_text),
        names_to  = "metric",
        values_to = "value"
      ) |>
      mutate(
        metric = recode(metric,
          pct_headline = "Headline", pct_datetime = "Datetime",
          pct_author   = "Author",   pct_text     = "Text"
        ),
        value = value * 100,
        value_offset = value + offsets[metric]
      ) |>
      ggplot(aes(x = tested_at, y = value_offset, colour = metric, group = metric)) +
        geom_hline(yintercept = 50, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey70") +
        geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
        geom_point(size = 2.5, aes(shape = metric)) +
        scale_shape_manual(values = c(Headline = 16, Datetime = 17, Author = 15, Text = 18)) +
        scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-1, 101), labels = \(x) paste0(x, "%")) +
        scale_colour_manual(values = c(
          Headline = "#e74c3c", Datetime = "#3498db",
          Author   = "#2ecc71", Text     = "#f39c12"
        )) +
        labs(x = NULL, y = "Extraction rate", colour = NULL, shape = NULL) +
        theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
        theme(legend.position = "bottom", panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
  }

  print(p)
  dev.off()
}
```

### Scraper Status

```{r}
#| label: status-table

display <- results |>
  mutate(
    http_pct     = ifelse(
      is.na(n_articles_attempted) | n_articles_attempted == 0, NA_real_,
      round(n_http_success / n_articles_attempted * 100)
    ),
    pct_headline = round(pct_headline * 100),
    pct_datetime = round(pct_datetime * 100),
    pct_author   = round(pct_author   * 100),
    pct_text     = round(pct_text     * 100),
    tested_at    = ifelse(
      is.na(tested_at), "—",
      format(as.POSIXct(tested_at), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")
    )
  ) |>
  select(domain, health, http_pct, pct_headline,
         pct_datetime, pct_author, pct_text, tested_at)

datatable(
  display,
  rownames  = FALSE,
  filter    = list(position = "top", clear = FALSE),
  colnames  = c("Domain", "Status", "HTTP %", "Headline %",
                "Datetime %", "Author %", "Text %", "Last Tested"),
  options   = list(
    pageLength = 30,
    order      = list(list(1, "asc")),
    dom        = "lftip",
    initComplete = JS("function() {
      var api = this.api();
      var col = api.column(1);
      var filterCell = $(api.table().header()).find('tr').eq(1).find('th, td').eq(1);
      filterCell.empty();
      var statuses = ['ok', 'degraded', 'broken', 'error', 'no_rss', 'untested'];
      var select = $('<select class=\"form-control form-control-sm\" style=\"width:100%\"><option value=\"\">All</option></select>')
        .appendTo(filterCell)
        .on('change', function() { col.search($(this).val(), true, false).draw(); });
      $.each(statuses, function(i, d) {
        select.append('<option value=\"' + d + '\">' + d + '</option>');
      });
    }")
  ),
  selection = "none"
) |>
  formatStyle(
    "health",
    backgroundColor = styleEqual(names(health_bg),  unname(health_bg)),
    color           = styleEqual(names(health_col), unname(health_col)),
    fontWeight      = "bold"
  ) |>
  formatStyle(
    c("http_pct", "pct_headline", "pct_datetime", "pct_author", "pct_text"),
    backgroundColor = styleInterval(c(49, 79), c("#f8d7da", "#fff3cd", "#d4edda"))
  )
```

# Domain Detail

```{r}
#| label: domain-detail
#| echo: false
#| output: asis

# Build dropdown
cat('<div style="margin-bottom: 20px;">\n')
cat('<label for="domain-select" style="font-weight:600; margin-right:8px;">Domain:</label>\n')
cat('<select id="domain-select" onchange="showDomain(this.value)" style="padding:6px 12px; font-size:14px; border:1px solid #ced4da; border-radius:4px; min-width:280px;">\n')
for (d in all_domains) {
  cat(sprintf('  <option value="%s">%s</option>\n',
              gsub("[^a-zA-Z0-9]", "-", d), d))
}
cat('</select>\n')
cat('</div>\n\n')

# Build one hidden div per domain
for (d in all_domains) {
  h      <- domain_histories[[d]]
  rss    <- status_info$rss[status_info$domain == d]
  div_id <- gsub("[^a-zA-Z0-9]", "-", d)
  img_id <- paste0(div_id, ".png")

  # Badge
  if (nrow(h) == 0) {
    badge <- '<span class="badge bg-secondary" style="font-size:0.9rem;">UNTESTED</span>'
    last  <- "Never tested"
  } else {
    badge_class <- switch(h$health[1],
      ok       = "bg-success",
      degraded = "bg-warning text-dark",
      broken   = "bg-danger",
      error    = "bg-danger",
      "bg-secondary"
    )
    badge <- sprintf('<span class="badge %s" style="font-size:0.9rem;">%s</span>',
                     badge_class, toupper(h$health[1]))
    last  <- format(as.POSIXct(h$tested_at[1]), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")
  }

  # RSS link
  rss_link <- if (length(rss) == 0 || is.na(rss) || !nzchar(trimws(rss))) {
    "<em class='text-muted'>No RSS feed</em>"
  } else {
    sprintf('<a href="%s" target="_blank" class="text-break">%s</a>', rss, rss)
  }

  # Emit div
  cat(sprintf('<div id="domain-%s" class="domain-section" style="display:none;">\n', div_id))
  cat('<div style="display:flex; gap:24px; align-items:center; margin-bottom:12px; flex-wrap:wrap;">\n')
  cat(sprintf('  <div><strong>Status:</strong> %s</div>\n', badge))
  cat(sprintf('  <div><strong>Last tested:</strong> %s</div>\n', last))
  cat(sprintf('  <div><strong>RSS:</strong> %s</div>\n', rss_link))
  cat('</div>\n')
  cat(sprintf('<img src="assets/plots/%s" style="width:100%%; max-width:800px; border:1px solid #dee2e6; border-radius:4px;">\n', img_id))
  cat('</div>\n\n')
}

# JavaScript to show/hide on dropdown change, and show first domain on load
cat('
<script>
function showDomain(id) {
  document.querySelectorAll(".domain-section").forEach(function(el) {
    el.style.display = "none";
  });
  var el = document.getElementById("domain-" + id);
  if (el) el.style.display = "block";
}
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
  var sel = document.getElementById("domain-select");
  if (sel) showDomain(sel.value);
});
</script>
')
```

# Run History

```{r}
#| label: run-history

if (nrow(runs) == 0) {
  cat("_No test runs recorded yet._")
} else {
  runs |>
    mutate(
      started_at   = format(as.POSIXct(started_at), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M"),
      completed_at = ifelse(
        is.na(completed_at), "—",
        format(as.POSIXct(completed_at), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")
      )
    ) |>
    datatable(
      rownames  = FALSE,
      colnames  = c("Run ID", "Started", "Completed", "Domains Tested", "Status"),
      options   = list(pageLength = 20, dom = "tip"),
      selection = "none"
    )
}
```
